items: 【AI-Powered for Maximum Productivity】This brand-new 11-inch tablet is equipped with the latest Android 15 and Gemini AI technology. It can process multiple types of data such as text, images, and audio simultaneously, accurately capturing the correlations between different parts of the data. Whether it is complex document analysis or long-form speech transcription, it can be accomplished efficiently and accurately, easily boosting work efficiency.

【Powerful Performance, Endless Storage】ANTEMPER Android 15 tablet is equipped with 16GB RAM (8GB physical RAM+8GB virtual RAM) and 128GB internal storage. It also supports up to 1TB of expandable storage (excluding TF cards). This configuration enables smoother multitasking, eliminating lag and crashes. With sufficient storage space, there is no need to frequently clean and delete files, completely alleviating your 'storage anxiety'.

【Immersive Entertainment That Lasts All Day】The Android 15 tablet features an 11-inch 1280x800 HD display with vibrant colors and dual stereo speakers. Paired with a large-capacity 7000mAh battery and an efficient system, it ensures uninterrupted all-day use with long-lasting battery life. Whether you are watching your favorite shows, browsing the web, or playing casual games, it delivers an excellent and immersive audiovisual experience.

【 Always Online, From Anywhere】11-inch tablet integrates both 4G cellular and Wi-Fi capabilities, offering significantly greater convenience than traditional Wi-Fi-only tablets by allowing you to stay connected anytime, anywhere. It is equipped with dual SIM card slots (SIM cards sold separately) that support the 4G LTE network,Its VoLTE support further allows you to handle data while on a call, so both communication and work can proceed without interruption. Additionally, the device supports fast AC dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4GHz/5GHz) and efficient Bluetooth 5.0 wireless connectivity, providing you with a comprehensive and stable experience for network and device connections.

【Capture Life's Moments in High Definition】This 5G WiFi tablet is equipped with a powerful camera system. The 13-megapixel rear camera helps you capture stunning photos and videos of your life, while the 8-megapixel front camera ensures clear video call quality. Whether you are documenting beautiful scenery on your travels or need to attend online classes or video conferences, it is the ideal choice for capturing precious moments and maintaining clear communication.

【The Complete All-in-One Value Package】Unbox your full potential from day one. This isn't just a tablet; it's a complete, all-in-one experience waiting for you. We've included a responsive Bluetooth keyboard, a wireless mouse, and a precision stylus to instantly transform your stunning 11-inch tablet into a powerful workstation or creative canvas. Forget about the extra cost and hassle of finding compatible accessories—we've already added a perfectly fitted foldable case and a screen protector to keep your device safe. This is everything you need, all in one box, offering unbeatable value.

【Your Perfect Companion for Daily Life】Unlock a world of vibrant clarity and seamless power. Whether you’re juggling work projects with the effortless split-screen feature or exploring a new city with reliable GPS, this tablet is your perfect companion. Its stunning 11-inch screen brings your favorite content to life, while the MTK octa-core processor ensures everything runs smoothly. With an interface that feels natural from the first touch and privacy you can trust, it’s designed to fit perfectly into every part of your day.

【A Promise of Quality, A Full Year of Protection】Every purchase you make comes with a full year of peace of mind. For one full year from your date of purchase, we provide a comprehensive after-sales guarantee covering any product quality issues not caused by human factors. Our professional customer service team is always on standby, dedicated to offering fast and convenient solutions to ensure your issues are handled promptly. Choosing us means choosing a 365-day worry-free experience, because our confidence in our product is your guarantee of satisfaction.
